title: Semantic HTML Skeleton
description: Proper document structure using semantic elements.
explanation_md: Semantic HTML uses tags that convey the meaning of the content to both the browser and the developer.

title: Responsive Video Embed
description: Embedding a video that scales with the container.
explanation_md: This technique uses an aspect ratio box to ensure the iframe maintains a 16:9 ratio while being responsive.

title: Form with Validation
code:
<form>
  <label for="email">Email:</label>
  <input type="email" id="email" required>
  <label for="zip">Zip Code:</label>
  <input type="text" id="zip" pattern="[0-9]{5}" title="Five digit zip code">
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>
explanation_md: HTML5 provides built-in validation via attributes like `required`, `type="email"`, and `pattern`.

title: Data Attributes
explanation_md: Data attributes allow you to store extra information on standard, semantic HTML elements.

title: SVG Icon
code:
<svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
  <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle>
  <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line>
  <line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line>
</svg>
explanation_md: Inline SVGs are scalable, stylable via CSS, and don't require additional HTTP requests.
